# Grand Line Fleet — machine-readable service directory

> 21 self-hosted micro-SaaS apps (FastAPI+SQLite+Docker) sold as source you own.
> Payable by humans via BTC/USDT, and by agents via x402 (USDC on Base).
> This file is stable; live service URLs rotate — resolve via go/?app=<slug>&p=<path>
> or fetch ./live_urls.json for the current slug→host map.

## Resolve a live service URL

- Redirect: GET https://seyitwb-svg.github.io/grand-line-fleet/go/?app={slug}&p={path}
  → 302-ish JS redirect to the current live host (free tunnel URLs rotate).
- Machine map: GET https://seyitwb-svg.github.io/grand-line-fleet/live_urls.json
  → {"slug": "https://<current-host>", ...} — refreshed every 10 minutes.

Slugs: goldshop (store), heard, formdock, statuspage, queueme, dockroom,
jobdesk, quotedeck, hourjar, bookme, cronwatch, metrik, newsdock, markdock,
proofdock, talkdock, secretdock, ogdock, qrdock, biodock, surveydock, board.

## Payable resources (x402 v2, USDC on Base eip155:8453)

Payment model: facilitator-free `exact` scheme with per-order amounts.
GET the resource → HTTP 402 whose `resource.url` carries a unique `oid`
and whose `accepts[0].amount` is a unique jittered amount for that order
(base price + up to 9999 extra units). Broadcast a USDC transfer of
EXACTLY `amount` to `payTo` (any wallet; facilitator-settled transfers
also verify) → GET the oid'd URL with `X-PAYMENT` holding the tx hash —
spec JSON `{"x402Version":2,"scheme":"exact","network":"eip155:8453",
"payload":{"txHash":"0x…"}}` or a bare `0x…` hash both work.
Verification parses the on-chain receipt (USDC Transfer events:
recipient + exact amount, race-safe atomic claim). Repeating the oid'd
URL without a tx re-serves the same requirement; repeating with the
same tx re-serves the result (idempotent).

- GET {goldshop}/x402/verify?tx=..&to=..&min=<units>&chain=base|bitcoin|tron
  — multi-chain settlement attestation (USDC-Base sats-BTC units-USDT-TRC20),
  Settlement attestation: which addresses received how much USDC in `tx`,
  block number, receipt id. ~$0.002 (exact amount given per order).
- GET {goldshop}/x402/{item} — buy source packages. Items: `hello`
  (~$0.01 — test the purchase flow end-to-end), `x402stack` ($9,
  secretdock+ogdock+qrdock — the three agent-payable apps),
  `app:<slug>` ($29 each), `app:goldshop` ($49, this checkout itself),
  `bundle` ($99, all 21 apps). Returns a download URL after on-chain
  verify.
- GET {goldshop}/x402/pagescan?url=<url> — fetch+parse any public URL: title, meta, links, text excerpt. ~$0.005/scan.
  Free demo (no payment): GET {goldshop}/x402/free/pagescan?url=<url>, 10/day.
- GET {goldshop}/x402/tokeninfo?address=<0x..> — ERC-20 info on Base: name, symbol, decimals, supply, contract size. ~$0.005/check.
- GET {ogdock}/x402/og.png — OG/social image render, $0.005 per call.
- GET {qrdock}/x402/qr.png — QR PNG render, $0.005 per call.
- GET {markdock}/x402/render — markdown → CommonMark HTML, $0.002.
- POST {secretdock}/x402/s — burn-after-read secret link, $0.01.
- GET/POST {formdock}/x402/inbox — webhook inbox: unique capture URL +
  private read endpoint, $0.01. Read via GET {formdock}/x402/inbox/{oid}.
- GET/POST {surveydock}/x402/poll?title=&q=&options=a,b,c — create a
  public poll: shareable vote link + live results link, $0.02.
- GET {goldshop}/.well-known/x402 — full resource discovery (31 entries).

## Human surfaces

- Store: go/?app=goldshop&p=/shop — BTC + USDT-TRC20 accepted, download
  unlocks automatically after 1 confirmation.
- Live status: go/?app=statuspage&p=/s/st-907738732f
- MIT sample (judge the code): https://github.com/seyitwb-svg/qrdock
- Repo: https://github.com/seyitwb-svg/grand-line-fleet

## Notes

- Prices in atomic units: 1 USDC cent = 10,000 units (6 decimals).
- One tx redeems exactly one order fleet-wide (atomic claim on the tx hash);
  unique per-order amounts also prevent accidental cross-order reuse.
- A payment broadcast but never claimed stays claimable only via its oid.
- Software is source-available: run, modify, self-host; do not resell source.
- Operated by an autonomous agent (Devin); settlement goes to operator wallet.
